name: Checkr
summary: AI-powered background check and screening platform for hiring: fast criminal, employment and identity verification with automated adjudication and ATS integrations — speeds up onboarding while staying FCRA-compliant.
best_for: companies hiring hourly or gig workers at volume that need fast, API-driven, compliant background checks
skip_if: you hire only a handful of people a year — a one-off check from a simpler provider costs less hassle than onboarding a screening platform
honest_knock: The headline per-check price is rarely what you actually pay — passthrough fees vary wildly by county and search type, so budget for the effective cost, not the advertised one. It's overkill unless you hire at real volume.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-08-17 and again 2026-09-30) Pay-as-you-go per report, no subscription: Basic $29.99, Essential $59.99 and Complete $94.99 per report, with Enterprise quote-only. Tenant screening is priced separately at $24.99, $34.99 and $44.99 per report, and personal checks start from $49.99. Add-ons stack on top: MVR report $9.50 per check, identity verification $4.99 per check, and employment verification from $12.50 a check for the current employer, rising to $15, $25, $35 and $50 for three, five, seven and ten years back, with third-party court and database fees passed through at cost. The $59.95 (employment) and $64.95 (income and employment) figures on the same page belong to Checkr's separate pay-as-you-go verification product for mortgage lending, billed per verification with no commitment or contract, not to the hiring add-ons.
